ns2:section.sectionText: Enrollment restricted to current actuarial science majors April 6 - April 27 and May 15 onwards. Students hoping to transfer to actuarial science should register on April 28 when the restriction is lifted during business hours and should not drop the course during the summer. Prospective transfers who are not able to register on April 28 may e-mail mathadvising@illinois.edu with name, netid, UIN, major, and year in school as of Fall 2015 (e.g. 2nd, 3rd) in order to be added to the Math 210 request list. Prospective transfers should also review http://www.math.uiuc.edu/~gorvett/actprob/transfer.html
